notes.title: THE LAST UPDATE (1.3)
notes.content:
Here we are with the latest Anarchy update! This new version brings a lot of new things. Some bugs were fixed too.

[b]Level Design[/b]

We have reworked 90% of the map. We wanted to add more vivid and less bland color.

[b]Maze -˃ LavaTower[/b]

The "Maze" has been totally changed. Now a tower called "LavaTower" has been installed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/46b2cccd5136a2d159ef399cca9ef21f3a1c00d6.png[/img]
Note: Climb as quickly as possible before the lava engulfs you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/c9136d24ef3c590cd4cd260dcdf8d587e5e598c8.png[/img]

[b]Pillars -˃ Labyrinth[/b]

The "Pillars" has been redesigned to make a sort of labyrinth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/69d07da879a502c3490ddae85ea128ba48b264ee.png[/img]
Note: Narrow space and you can stay imprisoned in rooms with only one exit.

[b]Tower -˃ JumpTower[/b]

The principle remains the same, we just rebuilt the exterior so that the visual is more beautiful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/00ce21a9d51a338f0c5f20a78bb10a91429ee41d.png[/img]
Note: Outside we put lava.

A train has been added. The train is not your friend. If he hits you ... I have to tell you what's going to happen?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/cadfa300857706b8f4c89d1a890ad6351c5c1c6e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/0fa7bb148eee97f36399f4303f19f36a555f407e.png[/img]
Version 1.2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/c9ccfc421506f23d8d0e70a9e72ba843dcd41956.png[/img]
Version 1.3

[b]NEW WEAPONS[/b]

Addition of several weapons which will be the most part in your inventory.

BARATON
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/0724da4c791a36f9272cb4d2ed1ee06343d08ad4.png[/img]

Pistoleter is back!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/1517408f89764978e6f16845e48c43c064d19f71.png[/img]

COWBOYBOY
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/95293c87ab7b744228b26fcff0fc9ad769dbcef2.png[/img]

To add another little challenge. Now you have no more unlimited balls. Your balls will be quite precious. Good luck!

[b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b]

- 2 boxes of life have been added.
- A last Robot has been added. The DaRobots is the predator at the top of the food chain. One blow and you die, no matter how bad the blow. (Robot with black texture)
- 4 videos of 25 seconds, one has been added to better understand how to have the 4 objectives.
- Teleport has been added next to the levers. Now you can descend safely.

[b] CONCLUSION [/ b]
 
THANK YOU VERY MUCH if you played ANARCHY. Your positive comments helped me to tweak ANARCHY. I am only 1 person behind this game. ANARCHY finds it very hard to find its audience. If you can help me just by leaving a review or telling your friends about it, would help me a lot. Thanks for reading, and hope to see you again in one of my next games! Kiss!

- Mathieu, STAMAND

notes.title: TEMPLEk UPDATE (1.2)
notes.content:
[b]Big update![/b]

The bunker was removed for the temple. When you enter the temple. You must activate the 4 door panels and start climbing up to the panels for the bunker door. Parkour will be put to your capacity. Traps that you should avoid too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/da13903789b77b3af8743376a938c1a5621c2d79.png[/img]

We replaced the pistol with a submachine gun, which is called The Predator, and the addition of 10 grenades to eliminate more enemies in large capacity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/afd3f9dfd98451278a67cd6447a6c4cc59aedc07.png[/img]

[u]THE PREDATOR[/u]

- 45 rounds of ammunition
- 25 bullet damage[img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/89b35c46a3ca30d617ac06c2fe1ad3f3dc570a8b.png[/img]

[u]GRENADE[/u]

- 10 grenades in your inventory
- 200 explosion damage

 New enemy (Red Robot) has been added. The RR is your number 1 enemy. Big damage kills you immediately. Small damage takes you away 25hp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37541108/f88d13ab96bec1cdfa1c327ff04f6a13c77ebea6.png[/img]

Small update that will come for this week.
- New menu
- Customizable button
